- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: 12746-12784, 13724 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The unresolved staged-support latch guard is applied only to the auto_approve branch, allowing the stall-judge-driven retrigger_implement branch to post /approved without checking the latch.
  WHY: An unresolved latch on an ai:awaiting-approval issue can therefore be bypassed and implementation re-entered despite the human gate remaining unresolved.

  WHY: Reviewers disagree on severity, but both identify that a preflight-detected staged-support rebase conflict can omit the machine-readable latch marker, causing the poller sweep to skip the issue and leave it parked for human intervention.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: 13724 and 12746-12784 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The staged-support latch guard is applied only inside the auto_approve case branch. When invoke_stall_judge returns retrigger_implement as the effective action, execute_stall_recovery_action at line 13724 dispatches to the retrigger_implement case (lines 12746-12784), which posts /approved without calling _staged_support_latch_release_incomplete.
  WHY: A half-released ai:awaiting-approval issue whose unresolved staged-support latch survived the auto_approve guard and then entered stall-judge escalation can have the judge return retrigger_implement, which posts an unguarded /approved and re-enters implementation despite the human gate never being resolved.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: 4074 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: SSB_AUTO_RELEASE_SAFE is sourced only from steps.commit_changes.outputs.staged_support_auto_release_safe with no preflight fallback, while SSB_REASON at line 4072 accepts both preflight and commit_changes outputs.
  WHY: A genuine 3-way rebase conflict caught by the preflight guard produces an ai:needs-human latch comment without the machine-readable marker, so the poller's release_staged_support_needs_human_latches sweep skips it with reason=no_staged_support_latch_comment, leaving the issue parked indefinitely when the engine has already been fixed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 14905-14912 (else branch of the standalone stall-recovery candidate loop, introduced in LAST RUN DIFF) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL-cache-miss fallback for standalone candidates was changed from a fail-open comments fetch (gh_retry gh api ... || echo '[]') to a fail-closed _staged_support_comments_for_guard call that skips the candidate entirely when the comments fetch fails.
  WHY: This blocks every recovery action for that candidate, not just the auto-approval path the latch guard was built for, so recovery is delayed by one poll tick per outage window.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: execute_stall_recovery_action, retrigger_implement case branch (around line 12786) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The unresolved-staged-support-latch guard (_staged_support_latch_release_incomplete) added in the last run is applied only inside the auto_approve case branch. The retrigger_implement branch also posts /approved but has no equivalent guard.
  WHY: When stall-judge-driven recovery returns retrigger_implement for an ai:awaiting-approval issue whose half-applied release left an unresolved staged-support latch, the retrigger_implement branch posts /approved without checking the latch, defeating the containment.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: lines 4073-4074 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: SSB_AUTO_RELEASE_SAFE is sourced only from steps.commit_changes.outputs.staged_support_auto_release_safe, while SSB_REASON accepts a fallback from steps.preflight_destructive_guard.outputs.staged_support_rebase_conflict.
  WHY: When the preflight destructive guard detects a genuine three-way staged-support rebase conflict before the commit_changes step runs, the handler omits the machine-readable latch marker and the poller sweep skips the issue with reason=no_staged_support_latch_comment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
